newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt paper yields ease further on active buying.
newsitem.headline: HK govt paper yields ease further on active buying.

text.p: Government short-dated bills continued to rise on Wednesday, leading paper yields down across the board on active buying, dealers said.
"Banks keep on buying government paper in preparation for the start of the Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS)," dealers said. Operation of the RTGS system will start on December 9.
The one-week bill yield plunged 22 basis points to 4.65 percent and one-month yielded 4.65 versus 4.86 on Tuesday.
"After the oversubscription of the special 28-day bills tendered on Tuesday, traders realised that demand for government paper is higher than expected," the dealer said.
